A '''castle''' was located on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Serenno/Legends|Serenno]]. Serenno was caught in a dispute with [[Celanon/Legends|Celanon]] over the placement of new [[Hyperwave transceiver/Legends|hyperwave transceivers]] that would disrupt existing [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperroutes]], exposing Serennian ships to greater tariffs. [[Count of Serenno/Legends|Count]] [[Vemec]] of Serenno convened a [[Conference on Serenno|conference]] on the issue in the [[Castle/Legends|castle's]] conference room with [[Minister]] [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Damask]]&mdash;the head of [[Damask Holdings/Legends|Damask Holdings]] and a major figure in the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan]], as well as a Sith Lord&mdash;which was mediated by Jedi Master [[Jocasta Nu/Legends|Jocastu Nu]], assisted by Dooku and his apprentice [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]].<ref name="DP" />
